messages:
anya: Quick thread on balancing packing efficiency vs tenant fairness. idea: represent eviction policy as a small multidimensional lattice instead of a single numeric score. this lets us pick actions mapped to combined signals rather than threshold hacks.

miguel: can you sketch the axes?

anya: sure: latency_slo_pressure, kv_cache_pressure, tenant_backlog, recent_hedges. those four normalized axes -> lattice cell -> action set (soft_evict, hard_evict, defer_prefetch, route_variant).

priya: main concerns: oscillation and observability. if tenants flip states too fast, we'll cause more harm. also we need clear metrics for SREs.

sam: hysteresis + per-tenant transition caps. require sustained metric delta for X seconds and cap transitions to Y per minute. also do bounded exponential backoff for replay after eviction.

kyle: replay tokens with backoff sounds right. and small-request fastpath should bypass hard evictions: don't punish tiny requests.

priya: observability surface: eviction_decisions(action,tenant,reason), lattice_coords, eviction_cooloff_remaining, queue_compactness, tenant_fairness_index, fallback_model_delta. console timeline view would help debugging.

miguel: runtime actions should be minimal: 1) soft_evict (exclude from coalesces but keep KV), 2) hard_evict (drop KV), 3) defer_prefetch, 4) route_variant. soft must be non-blocking on admission.

sam: implement controller as async writer. controller decides, writes decision records to central store with generation and ttl; hosts cache and read. hosts only read cache on admission if present else proceed. avoids on-path RPCs.

anya: decision record proto sketch: {tenant_id, lattice_coord, action, reason_tags, generation, ttl_secs}. hosts apply only if generation >= local_gen.

miguel: scope decisions by failure domain: region, host, global. controller writes scoped decisions; hosts prefer region over global.

kyle: rollout: dry-run emit-only 48h, then enable soft_evict on 1% hosts, expand, then hard_evict later. abort conditions: tenant p99 +5% or fallback_model_delta consistently bad.

priya: tests: synthetic kv pressure + adversarial tenants, chaos for controller flaps, compare dynamic fair_score vs credit-based.

sam: action items:
- sam: controller dry-run + metrics (2w)
- kyle: fair_score + small-request short-circuit
- miguel: synthetic workloads + chaos tests
- priya: metrics + Eviction Explorer wireframe

anya: tagging @oncall for eyes during dry-run. will write RFC follow-up with lattice spec and controller API tomorrow.

deploy-bot: dry-run rollout scheduled 6500002300 to staging.

anya: thanks all, closing.
